sections.title: About FoldBridge
sections.body: Ribocentre-FoldBridge (FoldBridge) connects residue-level RNA chemical-probing profiles from RMDB and RASP to experimentally resolved PDB chains. Each Entry keeps the source signal, sequence mapping, structure state, and confidence evidence together so you can move from an observed probing signal to the structure it maps onto.

items.title: Open Search
items.body: Choose Search in the navigation bar to open the site-wide search page.
items.alt: FoldBridge navigation bar with Search selected

items.title: Search by keyword
items.body: Enter a molecule name, PDB ID, or probing method, then select Search.
items.alt: FoldBridge Search field with a riboswitch keyword and Search button

items.title: Review the results
items.body: Browse the matching records and select a result to open its linked Entry page.

items.title: Open an Entry
items.body: Select a molecule name in the results to open its structure-linked Entry page.
items.alt: FoldBridge Entry row with a molecule name selected

items.title: Read the sequence mapping
items.body: Trace the selected nucleotide across the probing profile and PDB sequence alignment.
items.alt: FoldBridge sequence mapping with a selected nucleotide

items.title: Inspect the 2D structure
items.body: Use the secondary-structure view to see the selected position in its RNA context.

items.title: Explore the 3D structure
items.body: Inspect the mapped nucleotide in the interactive tertiary-structure viewer.

sections.title: Data collection and alignment
sections.body: FoldBridge combines per-residue chemical-probing data from RMDB / RASP with experimentally resolved PDB chains. Each probing sequence is aligned to its corresponding chain, and only residues with resolved structural coordinates enter confidence scoring. Records without a usable mapping or signal are flagged or excluded rather than force-scored.

sections.title: How to make a feedback
sections.body: We welcome your feedback, ideas, and suggestions. They help us keep FoldBridge useful, functional, and user-friendly. When possible, include the relevant page URL, PDB ID, chain, profile, or a screenshot so we can reproduce the issue.
